rna_source_policy: matching official EBI GOA RNA GAF/GPI retained by hash; original upstream URLs are mutable, not archived URLs
supplemental_evidence_use: separate direct gene-term counts, never primary positives
negative_annotation_use: NOT rows excluded; never training negatives
alternate_id_policy: resolve explicit alt_id entries to active primary terms
obsolete_and_unknown_term_policy: exclude and audit; no replacement inference
aspect_mismatch_policy: exclude and audit GAF aspect/ontology namespace mismatch
annotation_extension_policy: retain row context; gene-term positive asserts evidence in at least one reported context
uniprot_mapping: exact accession to Approved HGNC uniprot_ids to explicit Ensembl gene IDs; GPI retained as metadata, no GPI or symbol fallback
rnacentral_mapping: union explicit human RNAcentral 27.0 HGNC-to-Approved-HGNC-Ensembl and ENSEMBL_GENCODE gene-ID candidates
rnacentral_taxon_suffix: append _9606 only from explicit taxon=9606 mapping rows; GAF IDs must match exactly
ensembl_version_policy: normalize only explicit ENSG identifiers with optional numeric version to stable IDs
ambiguous_identifier_policy: exclude global one-to-many product-to-gene mappings before universe or biotype filtering
evaluation_universe: GENCODE v50 protein_coding and lncRNA on chr1-22 and chrX
split_policy: reuse label-free split and purged fitting roles; no label-driven reassignment
aspect_annotated_denominator: union of experimentally annotated universe genes in each aspect under this identical filter, before task exclusions

panel_rule.clustering: connected components across all panel-supported terms using propagated positive sets
panel_rule.cluster_rank: decreasing component size, then lexicographically smallest GO ID
panel_rule.representative: largest propagated positive set, then lexicographically smallest GO ID
panel_rule.hierarchy_constraint: no final representative is an is_a/part_of ancestor or descendant of any development representative
panel_rule.conflicting_final_cluster_policy: skip with reason, then inspect next ranked cluster
panel_rule.shortage_policy: report unfilled slots and block admission; no fallback

lncrna_stratum: intergenic and nearest protein-coding TSS distance strictly >50000 bp, intersected with evaluation universe
metrics_required_on_future_results: pooled out-of-fold term AP and each selector's identically configured shuffled reference
reporting_gate_scope: each AP's actual scoring domain must have >=25 positives; an individual fold with 5 positives is admitted to the panel but cannot receive a separately reported AP
temporal_benchmark: a separately pinned earlier GO release is required for CAFA/SOTA comparison; outside this milestone
next_gate: separate-code/process replay of source/ID/ontology derivation and GO-specific admission adapter
